name: UAV_Benchmarks
description: UAV_Benchmarks measures visual perception and tracking performance for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) / drone data. It contains aerial imagery and annotations to evaluate tasks such as object detection, tracking, and segmentation under varying viewpoints, scales, and environmental conditions. The benchmark is intended to test model robustness to occlusion, motion blur, and changes in altitude and viewpoint.
reputation: A useful dataset for UAV vision research with moderate adoption in the academic drone-vision community but not a single, widely standardized benchmark.
